maya: Quick UX review — streaming chat: we need a final call on how Stop/Abort/Pause behave. Proposal: single control that toggles streaming on/off; click once to Pause (preserve partial tokens), long-press or secondary action to Cancel (discard). Thoughts? @sam @lex :thinking: sam: I like clear language. Users expect 'Stop' to mean cancel. 'Pause' suggests they'll resume and the model keeps state. Maybe UI should show both: 'Pause' primary, small 'Cancel' icon next to it. lex: Accessibility nit: if we expose both controls, ensure SR announces current state. Use aria-live="polite" for token stream and announce "generation paused" or "generation stopped". ariane: Token counter idea: show 'live' tokens but with condensed format: '56 → 102' where arrow shows tokens generated in this response. Tooltip explains counting logic. Also consider dark contrast for small counters. harry: Regenerate behavior: when user hits regen mid-stream, what should happen? Abort current, then queue regen, or merge prompts? I'd prefer immediate abort + open composer with previous output as draft. maya: +1 on abort+draft. For UX copy: 'Pause' tooltip "Hold to cancel"? That might be confusing. Maybe use ellipsis menu for Cancel action. sam: Quick mock: [link to figma] https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/stream-ux — shows pause primary, kebab menu with 'Cancel generation' and 'Regenerate'. lex: Example aria snippet: ```
Generating... 56 tokens
``` Also ensure focus order doesn't trap keyboard users when stream ends. ariane: Accessibility contrast: token badge needs 3:1? Actually for small text needs 4.5:1. Let's use stronger fill or larger font. harry: Edge case: long response + pause then resume — KV cache should keep state. UX should show 'resuming...' spinner. :spinner: maya: Nice. Action items: - sam: update figma to include kebab cancel. - lex: write aria copy + snippet for devs. - ariane: token badge contrast variants. - harry: confirm regen flow with runtime team. maya: Also quick question: streaming token meter — do we show per-token latency (ms) in debug mode? @deploy-bot, any concerns with telemetry? deploy-bot: ops: no blocking concerns. Telemetry is off by default in preview builds; can gate via feature flag `stream_token_debug`. sam: I'll add a small tertiary label "debug: ms/token" behind a feature flag. maya: Thanks all. Going to consolidate into a tiny design doc. lex: :thumbsup: ariane: :eyes: will test colors in dark mode. harry: I'll ping runtime for regen SLA. maya: Cool — closing thread.
